crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even Yahweh on many waters.
You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.
You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.
I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the…
God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass…
The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.
“Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,
Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,
They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”
“Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
“In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its…
Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory…
Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

translations.web: Yahweh sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, Yahweh sits as King forever.
translations.bsb: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
translations.kjv: The LORD sitteth upon the flood; yea, the LORD sitteth King for ever.
translations.asv: Jehovah sat as King at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.
